verdict.rationale: Fedora's docs claim up-to-date packages, tools and runtimes installable with a single command, plus the latest container tools and easy app installs from Fedora repositories and Flathub. That covers the toolchain and IDE part of the story at the claim level. The AI/ML part is undermined: one user reports CUDA support is missing, and another cites NVIDIA driver issues, both relevant to GPU-based ML work. Missing for 10: any evidence of AI/ML framework or CUDA/GPU-compute support, evidence that IDE and AI vendors treat Fedora as a primary supported platform, and independent hands-on corroboration of the toolchain claims.
